sources.role: Application identity, archive and manual links, documented survival significance issue.
Original Fortran routines and separate mathematical/user documentation; locally compiled numerical references. Original source and binaries are not bundled.
User manual, February 2010, including the one-sample normal power example (difference 1, SD 10, n 156, power 0.344).

implementation: Independent mathematical implementations. No original Fortran routine or manual text is incorporated in the package.

reference.reproduction: In an empty build directory, compile the listed original source files in order together with the repository harness, using the listed flags and -o reference_stplan. Run reference_stplan and capture stdout as the CSV fixture. The original archive must be acquired separately.

compatibility: Two-sided power halves alpha and retains only the dominant rejection tail.
Correlation formulas follow current cor_nor_app_mod, pcor1 and pcor2, including the null SD for one-sample power.
Lognormal CV is SD/mean, consistent with qlgn2 and its formula.
Modern tail evaluation does not reproduce original quantile probability clamps.

discrete_reference.reproduction: In an empty build directory, compile the listed original source files in order together with this repository harness, using the listed flags and -o reference_stplan_discrete. Run the executable and capture stdout as the CSV fixture. The original archive must be acquired separately.
discrete_reference.empty_region: Two fixture rows retain the native -1 sentinel for an empty exact-test rejection region. Python intentionally returns the mathematically valid power 0 for these rows.

mixture_reference.reproduction: Compile the listed original source files in order with the repository harness in an empty build directory using the listed flags. Run the resulting executable and capture stdout as the native CSV fixture. Original source must be acquired separately.
mixture_reference.independent_runtime: R 4.4.1, base and stats packages only
mixture_reference.independent_method: Finite probability sums enumerate nonrandomized binomial rejection regions. Matched tests fix the upper-tail null at 0.5; Poisson tests mix over total events, with omitted reference mass below 1e-14.
native_defects: fmcaco passes case-only probability as the binomial null and 0.5 as its alternative, contrary to the intended null of 0.5.
ppoi2 uses a renormalized 99% Poisson sum, can duplicate integer modes, and substitutes a single test at the mean above 200 events.
